title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Unknown/Reserved Error Code Handling Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback integration tests and unit tests for STOP_SENDING dispatch prevention, unsolicited RESET_STREAM tolerance, and registered error code documentation.
scope: This verification covers server-side STOP_SENDING dispatch prevention, client-side unsolicited RESET_STREAM counting with configurable threshold, and registered error code pathway documentation.
preconditions: Managed QUIC loopback support is available for integration tests.
expected_result: All DoQ tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0010, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves STOP_SENDING dispatch prevention on the server, configurable unsolicited RESET_STREAM tolerance on the client, and registers the error code pathway. All three REQs are traced and verified.
